description: Combined quantitative comparison of hmg1 and hmg2 expression across GSE256524 (iron starvation), GSE30579 and GSE133440 (hypoxia), with per-condition ratios
code:
import requests, pandas as pd, numpy as np, os
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
H1="Afu2g03700"; H2="Afu1g11230"
cwd=os.getcwd()

# ---------- GSE133440 ----------
f=pd.read_csv(os.path.join(cwd,"GSE133440_FPKM.csv.gz"),compression="gzip")
f2=f.set_index(f.columns[0]).apply(pd.to_numeric,errors="coerce")
T=pd.DataFrame({"hmg1_FPKM":f2.loc[H1],"hmg2_FPKM":f2.loc[H2]})
T["ratio"]=T.hmg1_FPKM/T.hmg2_FPKM.replace(0,np.nan)
print("=== GSE133440 (AF293/CEA10, biofilm & planktonic, normoxia vs hypoxia, hrmA mutants) ===")
print(T.round(3).to_string())
pct1=(f2.lt(f2.loc[H1],axis=1)).mean()*100; pct2=(f2.lt(f2.loc[H2],axis=1)).mean()*100
print("\nmedian transcriptome percentile: hmg1 %.1f | hmg2 %.1f" % (pct1.median(),pct2.median()))
print("samples with hmg2 FPKM == 0: %d/%d" % ((f2.loc[H2]==0).sum(), f2.shape[1]))
wt=[c for c in T.index if c.startswith("AF293_") or c.startswith("CEA10_")]
print("\nWild-type-only subset:"); print(T.loc[wt].round(3).to_string())

# ---------- GSE256524 ----------
E=pd.read_csv(os.path.join(cwd,"GSE256524_hmg1_hmg2_rpkm.csv"))

# ---------- GSE30579 ----------
d=pd.read_csv(os.path.join(cwd,"GSE30579_normalized_data.txt.gz"),sep="\t",compression="gzip")
g=d[d["Locus_Tag"].isin(["AFUA_2G03700","AFUA_1G11230"])].set_index("Locus_Tag")
tc=pd.DataFrame({"hmg1":g.loc["AFUA_2G03700",["sample_T0","sample_T12","sample_T24","sample_T36"]].astype(float).values,
                 "hmg2":g.loc["AFUA_1G11230",["sample_T0","sample_T12","sample_T24","sample_T36"]].astype(float).values},
                index=["normoxia T0","hypoxia 12h","hypoxia 24h","hypoxia 36h"])
tc["ratio"]=tc.hmg1/tc.hmg2
print("\n=== GSE30579 hypoxia time course ===\n", tc.round(3).to_string())

# ---------- combined ratio table ----------
rows=[]
for cond,gg in E.groupby(["medium","condition"]):
    rows.append(dict(dataset="GSE256524 (RPKM)",condition=f"{cond[1]}, {cond[0]}",hmg1=gg.hmg1.mean(),hmg2=gg.hmg2.mean(),ratio=gg.hmg1.mean()/gg.hmg2.mean(),n=len(gg)))
for i,r in tc.iterrows():
    rows.append(dict(dataset="GSE30579 (norm.)",condition=i,hmg1=r.hmg1,hmg2=r.hmg2,ratio=r.ratio,n=1))
for grp,lab in [(["AF293_Normoxia.r1","AF293_Normoxia.r2","AF293_Normoxia.r3"],"AF293 planktonic normoxia"),
                (["AF293_Hypoxia.r1","AF293_Hypoxia.r2","AF293_Hypoxia.r3"],"AF293 planktonic hypoxia")]:
    sub=T.loc[grp]; rows.append(dict(dataset="GSE133440 (FPKM)",condition=lab,hmg1=sub.hmg1_FPKM.mean(),hmg2=sub.hmg2_FPKM.mean(),ratio=sub.hmg1_FPKM.mean()/sub.hmg2_FPKM.mean(),n=3))
C=pd.DataFrame(rows)
print("\n=== COMBINED: hmg1 vs hmg2 across every public condition resolving both paralogues ===")
print(C.round(3).to_string(index=False))
C.to_csv(os.path.join(cwd,"hmg1_hmg2_expression_summary.csv"),index=False)
print("\nminimum hmg1/hmg2 ratio observed anywhere:", round(C.ratio.min(),1), "| maximum:", round(C.ratio.max(),1))

# ---------- figure ----------
fig,ax=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(13,5.2))
lbl=C.condition+"\n"+C.dataset.str.split(" ").str[0]
y=np.arange(len(C))
ax[0].barh(y-0.19,C.hmg1,0.38,label="hmg1 (AFUA_2G03700)",color="#2f6690")
ax[0].barh(y+0.19,C.hmg2,0.38,label="hmg2 (AFUA_1G11230)",color="#d1495b")
ax[0].set_yticks(y); ax[0].set_yticklabels(lbl,fontsize=7.5)
ax[0].set_xscale("log"); ax[0].set_xlabel("normalised expression (RPKM / FPKM / normalised units, log scale)")
ax[0].set_title("Paralogue expression in every public A. fumigatus dataset\nthat resolves both HMG-CoA reductase genes",fontsize=10)
ax[0].legend(fontsize=8); ax[0].invert_yaxis()
ax[1].barh(y,C.ratio,color="#6b8f71")
ax[1].set_yticks(y); ax[1].set_yticklabels([]); ax[1].set_xscale("log")
ax[1].axvline(1,color="k",ls="--",lw=1); ax[1].text(1.15,len(C)-0.5,"parity",fontsize=8)
ax[1].set_xlabel("hmg1 / hmg2 expression ratio (log scale)")
ax[1].set_title("Ratio never approaches parity: 80x to 1240x\nin 36 samples spanning iron starvation and hypoxia",fontsize=10)
for i,v in enumerate(C.ratio): ax[1].text(v*1.1,i,f"{v:.0f}x",va="center",fontsize=7.5)
ax[1].invert_yaxis()
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
